name: bench-hello
title: hello-world programs, one per language (leachim6/hello-world), 1,002 labels
labels: the contributor (the language the file is named after)
strengths: the longest tail: 1,002 labels, esoteric languages included
extensions chosen by contributors, sometimes another language's (Pebble.c): 186 cases test what a tool does when the extension lies

weaknesses: a line or two (median 2 non-blank lines); 109 cases share their bytes with another language's program

704 of 1,009 cases in languages Linguist does not know
